summary: Round r1 (restricted network). All empirical items are pending. Holding size and fragmentation will come from the NSO National Sample Census of Agriculture 2021/22 (located by web search), with the FAO metadata review used to check comparability with the 2001/02 and 2011/12 rounds before any trend is stated. The food import bill will come from Department of Customs trade books (Nepal FY, fixed HS definition), cross-checked against the NRB major-imports table. Cereal import dependence will use FAOSTAT food balances (calendar year) and a Nepal-FY variant built from MoALD production and customs imports, with UN Comtrade India mirror data to gauge informal trade. Provincial food insecurity will come from NLSS IV 2022/23 and NDHS 2022, keeping each measure's definition separate, with WFP/NeKSAP and FAO SOFI as cross-checks. Soil health and water-availability sources were not located.

data_gaps: NSCA 2021/22 holdings tables not downloaded; earlier census reports (2011/12, 2001/02) URLs not located
Food import bill FY2080/81-FY2081/82: customs books not located
Cereal food balance (FAOSTAT FBS) not downloaded
Provincial food-insecurity prevalence: NDHS 2022 module presence unverified; NLSS IV tables not downloaded
Soil health (soil organic matter, nutrient status) and water availability for agriculture - no source located (NARC/Soil Management Directorate to be searched in r2)

assumptions.text: Food is defined as HS chapters 01-24 excluding 24 (tobacco) and 22 (beverages) unless a source uses another definition, which is then recorded with its definition.
Fragmentation trend is reported only between census rounds whose holding definitions are confirmed comparable.
Different food-insecurity measures (FIES, food sufficiency months, food consumption score) are not converted into one another.

challenges.text: Request catalog ids for WFP (NeKSAP), IPC and Nepal Trade Information Portal; request 'hectares' unit code.
Rice import dependence: 07C and 21D compute the same ratio; propose 21D own the essential-import ratio and 07C own the cereal FBS/production denominator, using one MoALD/FAOSTAT observation set.
NLSS IV provincial tables (07C-L12/L13) are also used by 10B/23C; food-insecurity items should be ingested once with standard errors.

uncertainty: All pending. Holding-size trends are sensitive to sampling and definitional changes between census rounds; the food import bill depends on the HS definition and misses informal trade across the open India border; food-insecurity prevalence varies strongly with the measure chosen, and provincial estimates carry sampling error that must be reported.

land_fragmentation_profile.method: From NSCA rounds: holdings (count), operated area (hectares), average holding size, parcels per holding, share of holdings by size class, tenure and female-operated share, by province; trend across 2001/02, 2011/12, 2021/22 only where holding definitions match (FAO metadata review). Soil health and water availability: qualitative pointers pending (no source located).

food_import_dependence.method: Food import bill from customs (Nepal FY, NPR_current_mn) with fixed HS definition; cereal import dependency ratio by crop from FAOSTAT FBS (calendar year) and a Nepal-FY variant from MoALD production + customs imports; mirror data from India for informal-trade gap; exposure to Indian export restrictions noted (DGFT 43/2023).

food_insecurity_by_province.method: Province-level prevalence from NLSS IV 2022/23 (food adequacy/sufficiency) and NDHS 2022 (household food insecurity module if present), each with its own definition and standard error; WFP NeKSAP phase data as monitoring cross-check; FAO SOFI national FIES as national benchmark.
